query: Who approved Quill Ferry’s winter timetable, and what is the first departure time?

source_chunks.heading: Quill working note 1
source_chunks.content:
A draft of the winter timetable names the first departure as 06:40. The
draft leaves the approval field blank.

To prepare the shared working folder, staff place the latest notes beside the intake
sheet and retain the previous copy in the archive. A coordinator checks the file
name and the date before the next handoff. If a document is missing, the team
records that gap and asks for the original; a replacement is not assumed to exist.
source_chunks.uncertainty: Source text has not been reviewed.

source_chunks.heading: Quill working note 2
source_chunks.content:
A separate timetable note lists the first winter departure as 07:10 and does
not identify the approver. Neither note records a final decision between the
two times.

For routine handoffs, open the checklist, mark the items already reviewed, and
leave the remainder for the next shift. The checklist is a record of work in
progress, not an authorization to change the underlying arrangement. Staff can
add a short note when a handoff crosses a weekend or a public holiday.
source_chunks.uncertainty: Source text has not been reviewed.

source_chunks.heading: Quill working note 3
source_chunks.content:
Staff should keep draft timetable copies together and label them with the
date received. The collection does not contain a signed approval record.

The office keeps a separate log for day-to-day questions. Each entry contains the
date received and a brief description, followed by the initials of the person
who filed it. Entries are reviewed in batches, and outdated drafts stay labeled
as drafts until someone supplies a verified replacement.
